 Galaxy S27 wallpaper leak hints at possible color options
 Thursday, 12 November 2026, 15:44 
 Photo source: Gizmochina 
 Five official-looking wallpapers apparently found in leaked firmware files offer a possible glimpse of the Galaxy S27 series palette, but do not establish its final colors. 
 The five images share a folded-ribbon design and come in cream/white, dark navy blue, light blue, pink and burgundy.
 This is reported by Gizmochina .
 Samsung has often paired its phones with default wallpapers that match their available finishes. That pattern has led people to view the images as a possible preview of the Galaxy S27 series colors. The palette includes neutral and pastel shades, as well as a deeper burgundy that has appeared less often in earlier color rumors.
 Advertisement 
 The wallpapers do not confirm the final production colors. Samsung may change the palette before launch or add online-only finishes for certain markets or models. For now, only static images have appeared.
 The Galaxy S27 series is currently a few months away. Expectations generally point to an announcement in early 2027, possibly in January, with standard, Plus, Pro and Ultra models. Other leaks have already suggested a new rear design and hardware changes.
 Confirmed color names, official renders and specifications may emerge closer to launch. Until then, the wallpapers remain an unofficial hint, not a final indication of the phones’ colors.
